Move through the planning stages. `next` is refused (409) until the current stage's
checklist is complete; going back is always allowed.

The plan's transcript, oldest first, with each message's form, choices or answer.

post.description:
Answer (or skip) the pending form, or pick from the pending choices. No model call:
the answer or pick is stored, the plan updated, and the planner moves on (running the
next search, if any), streaming `PlanningEvent`s that end in `done`.

Free text. While a form is pending it is read as that form's answer, and while
choices are pending as a pick (or answered as a question, or nudged back to the
question); otherwise it is a question about the trip.

Let the planner act with no new input: move on from a finished stage, run (or retry)
a search, or show the pending form again. With `refresh` ("More options"), search the
pending choices again for ones not offered yet.

AdvanceStage.title: AdvanceStage
AdvanceStage.description:
The current stage is done. The turn pipeline acts on this at once, so a client only
sees it on a stage the user went back to: it then offers to continue.

AnswerRecord.title: AnswerRecord
AnswerRecord.description: A user's answer to an input slot (message kind "input").

AppliedChange.title: AppliedChange
AppliedChange.description: One command that was written, as the transcript shows it.

AskInput.title: AskInput
AskInput.description: Show the slot's form. `prefill` holds values the plan already has.

CandidateChange.title: CandidateChange
CandidateChange.description:
The plan change picking a candidate makes: a write tool's name and arguments, run
through the same validation as any other change (`chat.tools.check_change`).

ChangesRecord.title: ChangesRecord
ChangesRecord.description:
What a message's commands did (message kind "changes"). Commands are written all or
nothing, so `rejected` is empty when anything was applied, unless the plan changed
between the check and the write.

ChoicePick.title: ChoicePick
ChoicePick.description:
Pick from the open offer: picking is the approval. The ids must be the offer's, and
as many as its pick slot takes.

Complete.title: Complete
Complete.description: At review: nothing left to ask. Remaining issues are in the assessment.

ContinueRequest.title: ContinueRequest
ContinueRequest.description:
`POST /plans/{id}/planning/continue`. With `refresh`, the pending choices are
searched again for other options ("More options"); without it (or with no body) the
planner just carries on.

A change of place with no transfer to cover it (found by `itinerary.gaps`).

`None` item ids mean the traveller's home: `after_item_id=None` is the trip's start
(home → first stop) and `before_item_id=None` is its end (last stop → home).

IssueCode.description:

warnings use the same codes.

PlanPreferences.title: PlanPreferences
PlanPreferences.description:
Stored on the plan (`travel_plans.preferences`); a plan saved before this existed
reads as all None.

PlanStage.title: PlanStage
PlanStage.description:
The planning workflow, in order. A StrEnum rather than a Literal so the OpenAPI spec
names it and the generated SDK exports it as a constant the UI can iterate.

PlanSummary.title: PlanSummary
PlanSummary.description: Lightweight row for the plans sidebar.

PlanUpdate.title: PlanUpdate
PlanUpdate.description:
Partial update: only fields present in the request body are applied.

The date range is re-checked by the service against the merged plan, since a patch may
carry only one of the two dates.

PlanningDoneEvent.title: PlanningDoneEvent
PlanningDoneEvent.description: The turn finished; `plan` (with its assessment) is what the UI shows next.

PlanningErrorEvent.title: PlanningErrorEvent
PlanningErrorEvent.description: The turn failed; `message` is the stored notice, when it could be saved.

PlanningMessage.title: PlanningMessage
PlanningMessage.description: One transcript entry. `payload` holds the form, choices or answer it showed.

PlanningMessageEvent.title: PlanningMessageEvent
PlanningMessageEvent.description:
A message was stored: the user's input, the assistant's reply or nudge, the next
form or choices, a stage divider. Clients append it to the transcript.

PlanningPlanEvent.title: PlanningPlanEvent
PlanningPlanEvent.description: The plan changed (an answer, a pick, a stage move).

PlanningStatusEvent.title: PlanningStatusEvent
PlanningStatusEvent.description: Something slow is running, e.g. "Finding flights out…". Not stored.

PlanningText.title: PlanningText
PlanningText.description: Free text typed into the composer (`POST /plans/{id}/planning/chat`).

PlanningTokenEvent.title: PlanningTokenEvent
PlanningTokenEvent.description: Part of the assistant's streamed answer to a question; the stored message follows.

RejectedChange.title: RejectedChange
RejectedChange.description: One command the rules turned down, and the rule it broke.

ReturnToStage.title: ReturnToStage
ReturnToStage.description:
A stage before the current one has a blocking issue again (an item was removed or
changed since it was finished), so the plan goes back to fix it. The turn pipeline acts
on this at once; a client only sees it after an edit outside a turn, and then offers to
go back.

RunSearch.title: RunSearch
RunSearch.description: Search for the slot's candidates (the "Find flights" / "Retry" button).

SlotAnswer.title: SlotAnswer
SlotAnswer.description:
The pending input slot's form, filled in. `value` is checked against the slot's
value model (`planning.answers.parse_answer`), so its shape depends on `slot`.

SlotName.title: SlotName
SlotName.description:
Every input the planning flow asks for (`planning.slots` holds the registry). It
lives here because a plan stores which optional slots the user declined.

SlotSkip.title: SlotSkip
SlotSkip.description: Skip the pending input slot; only optional slots (the budget) can be skipped.

max_per_person.description: The most one such activity may cost per person

SpendingLimit-Input.title: SpendingLimit
SpendingLimit-Input.description:
The most one activity of a category may cost per person (a plan setting, defined here
because it is about items).

max_per_person.description: The most one such activity may cost per person

SpendingLimit-Output.title: SpendingLimit
SpendingLimit-Output.description:
The most one activity of a category may cost per person (a plan setting, defined here
because it is about items).

StageChange.title: StageChange
StageChange.description:
Move the plan through the workflow: `next` (only when the current stage is ready),
`back`, `skip_flights` (from the flights stage, for a trip without flying) or `go_to`
an earlier `stage`.

StageRecord.title: StageRecord
StageRecord.description: The plan moved to another stage (message kind "stage").

StageStatus.title: StageStatus
StageStatus.description:
A stage's checklist: what still blocks it (`issues`), plus two views derived from
them for callers that only need a yes/no or the messages.

TimelineEntry.title: TimelineEntry
TimelineEntry.description: A card on one day. Items spanning midnight appear on every day they touch.
